scientific_integrity: The proof concerns characteristic roots of a linear velocity variation at a resting simplex, not nonlinear global or orbital stability. Classical Lambert-W spectral tools are credited, and numerical checks supplement the proof.
scientific_limitations: All configuration positions and uniform-velocity perturbations have neutral modes.
A complex dominant characteristic pair does not force oscillation of every history.
For p>1 the source fat-tail theorem does not provide nonlinear flocking.
No exhaustive priority search or independent validation has been conducted.
title: Reentrant dominant-spectrum transition in finite-speed simplex flocks
